title: Design Twitter Social Media
description: Model tweets, users, follows, likes, and timelines.

data.text: Design a Twitter-like system. Users post tweets, follow others, like tweets, and see a timeline of tweets from people they follow.

data.title: Tweet and TimelineService
Fan-out on write for Twitter
data.text: Like Facebook, Twitter benefits from push-based timelines. When a user tweets, push it to all followers' home timelines. Read becomes a simple cache lookup.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Tweet is the core content entity
Follow graph is a many-to-many relationship
Home timeline is tweets from followed users, reverse-chronological
Like is a lightweight engagement signal
data.takeaway: Twitter is a graph and timeline problem. The follow graph is the hard part. Timeline generation is just a sorted merge.
